title: Putting together an elemental combo system on my action roguelite
author: Cosmonan
selftext:
So I'm trying to create a Genshin Impact-inspired elemental combo system. The idea is for each attack button (square and triangle) to be assigned one element (so far Thunder and Fire), and successive attacks inflict the enemies with the element effect. Attacking with another element while the enemy is affected triggers a combo output. So far I have Thunder + Fire = Explosion.

The video shows every attack marking the enemy, but I figured it would be too OP and included an enemy magic shield bar to be broken before being able to be afflicted with an element.

 Currently elements are meta-progression, with the player choosing a combination of 2 before each run.  Fire, Thunder, Desert and Ice will be unlocked as the player progresses.

I'm not sure I am happy with this implementation though, want to hear from you guys what you think about the idea.
